title: 🔥 Hypnotic Pulsating Tiles – CSS Animation Magic! 🎨✨
description:
🚀 Dive into the world of CSS animations with this Pulsating Tiles Effect! Each tile smoothly expands and contracts in a hypnotic rhythm, creating a stunning visual illusion. This effect is achieved with pure CSS keyframes and nth-child selectors for dynamic delays and scaling. Perfect for adding an interactive and modern touch to your designs! 🎨✨

🔹 Tech Stack: HTML + CSS
🔹 Features: Colorful tiles, animated scaling, seamless transitions
🔹 No JavaScript needed!

💻 Try it out and let me know what you think! 🎬🔥
